# Canadian Bar Association

> > The Canadian Bar Association (CBA) is Canada's national organization representing over 36,000 lawyers, judges, notaries, law teachers, and law students across 13 provincial and territorial branches.

The CBA advances the rule of law, access to justice, and the interests of the legal profession through advocacy, public policy statements, legal research funding via the Law for the Future Fund, and strategic initiatives to strengthen internal cohesion and expand membership diversity.

## Key Topics

- Canadian Bar Association governance and structure
- Board of Directors and leadership
- Provincial and territorial branches
- Law for the Future Fund legal research grants
- CBA advocacy and public statements policy
- Access to justice initiatives
- Rule of law and legal profession standards
- Annual General Meeting resolutions
- Strategic direction and organizational cohesion
- Membership expansion and diversity
- CBA National Office in Ottawa
- Bylaws and sections regulation
- Policy Committee and intervention regulation
- Legal profession ethics and conduct
- Parliamentary advocacy and interventions

## Governance and Leadership

- [Governance](https://cba.org/about-us/governance): CBA governance structure, Board of Directors, and organizational bylaws
- [Strategic Direction for CBA](https://www.cba.org/about-us/governance/strategic-direction-for-cba): CBA mission, vision, and strategic priorities for the legal profession
- [Board of Director Members](https://www.cba.org/about-us/governance/board-of-directors/members): CBA Board of Directors member profiles and leadership information
- [Enhance Our Internal Cohesion](https://cba.org/about-us/governance/strategic-direction-for-cba/enhance-our-internal-cohesion): Strategic goal to strengthen CBA organizational cohesion and efficiency
- [Expand Our Membership](https://www.cba.org/about-us/governance/strategic-direction-for-cba/expand-our-membership): Strategic initiative for CBA membership growth and diversity expansion

## Organization and Structure

- [CBA Branches](https://cba.org/about-us/cba-branches): Directory of 13 CBA provincial and territorial branches across Canada
- [CBA National Office](https://cba.org/about-us/cba-national-office): CBA National Office staff directory and leadership team in Ottawa

## Legal Research and Funding

- [Law for the Future Fund](https://www.cba.org/about-us/cba-partners/law-for-the-future-fund): LFFF grant program funding innovative Canadian legal research since 1984
- [Application Information](https://cba.org/about-us/cba-partners/law-for-the-future-fund/application-information): LFFF grant application criteria, eligibility, and funding requirements

## Advocacy and Policy

- [CBA Advocacy and Public Statements Policy](https://cba.org/about-us/governance/operational-policies/cba-advocacy-and-public-statements-policy): CBA policy framework for advocacy, public statements, and interventions
- [Resolutions](https://cba.org/about-us/governance/annual-general-meeting/resolutions): AGM resolutions on AI impact, digital assets, and governance matters

## Bylaws and Regulations

- [Bylaws Number 1](https://www.cba.org/about-us/governance/bylaws-and-regulations/bylaws): CBA Bylaw No. 1: membership eligibility and organizational rules
- [Sections Regulation](https://www.cba.org/about-us/governance/bylaws-and-regulations/sections-regulation): CBA Sections Regulation governing national and branch legal sections

## Optional

- [Principles of Conduct](https://www.cba.org/about-us/governance/operational-policies/principles-of-conduct): CBA conduct standards for members, employees, and event participants
- [Transparency, Conflict and Anti-Corruption Policy](https://www.cba.org/about-us/governance/operational-policies/transparency-conflict-and-anti-corruption-policy): CBA anti-corruption, conflict of interest, and ethics guidelines
- [Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Policy](https://cba.org/about-us/governance/operational-policies/prevention-of-sexual-exploitation-and-abuse-psea-policy): PSEA policy for CBA International Initiatives safeguarding standards
